description: This file contains API service functions for interacting with backend endpoints related to events and weather data, including fetching event lists, creating events, and retrieving current weather and forecast data with normalization and error handling.

methods.name: debugLog(label, payload)
methods.description: Logs debug messages with a label and payload for troubleshooting.

methods.name: http(path, options = {})
methods.description: Wraps the fetch API to handle requests, handle errors, and normalize response envelopes.

methods.name: getEvents({ page = 1, page_size = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of events with pagination, normalizes the response to an array.

methods.name: createEvent(payload)
methods.description: Sends a POST request to create a new event with the provided payload.

methods.name: getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches current weather data based on query, coordinates, units, and language.

methods.name: getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {})
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data and normalizes various backend response formats into a { daily: [...] } shape.

ctags.name: getCurrentWeather
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getCurrentWeather({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: getForecast
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getForecast({ q, lat, lon, units = 'metric', lang } = {}) {$/
